scenarios.name: Existing global-email uniqueness
scenarios.finding: Original users_email_unique rejected synthetic cross-brand duplicate with SQLSTATE 23505.

scenarios.name: Platform-qualified normalized uniqueness
scenarios.finding: Candidate expression/partial unique index accepted independent platforms and rejected same-platform case/space variants. Injected DDL failure 22012 rolled back.

scenarios.name: Independent SUIA/RTH identities
scenarios.finding: Distinct person UUIDs and correct platform-qualified selection. Separate synthetic brand databases additionally used colliding local UUIDs.

scenarios.name: Bridge concurrent writes and retries
scenarios.finding: Eight concurrent sync calls and repeat reconciliation produced one person and one grant.

scenarios.name: Grant recovery and revocation
scenarios.finding: Authorized missing own-platform grant recovered. Soft-deleted grant restoration and cross-platform access were denied.

scenarios.name: Shadow links and interrupted operations
scenarios.finding: Foreign link denied, people commit retained across brand client failure, retry recovered. PostgreSQL trigger failure P0001 rolled back bridge person insertion.

scenarios.name: SSO authorization, locks and audit rollback
scenarios.finding: Real repository same-platform grant/revoke passed. Wrong role/brand and disabled actor denied. Lock timeout 55P03 and transactional audit-failure rollback verified.

scenarios.name: Seed conflict expression
scenarios.finding: Exact target expression upsert passed, repeat was a no-op and retained original synthetic credential hash.

scenarios.name: Migration chain and 0009 ordering
scenarios.finding: Normal pending upgrade from inherited 0000-0008 baseline through 0009 then candidate passed and repeated idempotently. Fresh full historical replay failed at duplicate 0006/0007 foreign key, SQLSTATE 42710.

scenarios.name: Recovery and cleanup
scenarios.finding: Real pg_dump/pg_restore synthetic-only logical recovery matched data/index/ledger fingerprints. Scratch resources cleaned. Owner-created branch retained for manual owner cleanup.
